claude_only.name: Which identifier is the authoritative public reference for this request, which body minted it, and at which lifecycle event was it minted?
Which additional identifiers exist for the same request, and what is the declared equivalence relation between them?
Is a tracking reference disclosed to the requester, and by when is disclosure required?
How are duplicate submissions of the same underlying request detected and reconciled without destroying either record?
Which published service or procedure, at which version, does this request instantiate?
What request intent does this record express - a proposal, a plan, or an actionable order to the receiving body?
Which classification schemes are applied to the request, and which of them are normative for processing rather than merely descriptive?
If the catalogue definition changes after submission, does the request remain governed by the version in force at submission?
Who is the beneficiary or subject of the request, and is that party distinct from the submitter?
Where a representative acts, what is the evidenced basis and scope of that mandate, and when does it expire?
Which party carries legal responsibility for the truth of the declarations, and which party receives official notifications?
How are role changes during processing - change of representative, death, insolvency, transfer of the underlying interest - recorded without rewriting history?
By what means was the submitter authenticated at submission, and at what assurance level?
Which asserted attributes were verified against an authoritative source, and which remain self-declared?
If identity could not be established to the required level, what proportionate additional identification was requested, and did the clock stop?
Is anonymous or pseudonymous submission permitted for this procedure, and what limits does that place on the outcome?
Which form or payload definition, at which version, does this instance conform to, and is that definition still retrievable?
Which declarations, attestations or consents did the requester make, and what is the legal effect of each?
In which language was the request submitted, and does the procedure require translation or a specific official language?
Which declared values are free text and which are bound to controlled vocabularies, and how are unbound values handled downstream?
Which requirement does each supplied evidence item discharge, and are any mandatory requirements still undischarged?
Is an evidence item still valid at the moment of reliance, and was its status checked then?
How is each attachment's integrity established and preserved between submission and reliance?
Where alternative evidence is acceptable, which alternative was chosen and who accepted the substitution?
Did the requester explicitly request that evidence be fetched from another authority, and how is that explicit request evidenced?
Was the retrieved evidence previewed by the requester before use, and could it be rejected?
Which authority provided the evidence, under which mapping between the requirement and that authority's evidence type?
What happens to the request when authoritative retrieval fails or returns no match?
Against which criteria is completeness assessed, and who is competent to make that determination?
When a deficiency is found, what must the notice tell the requester and by when must it be sent?
What effect does a deficiency have on the statutory clock - suspension, restart, or none - and on what legal basis?
If the requester does not cure the deficiency, what disposition follows and is it appealable?
Is completeness screening re-run after amendment, and does an amended request inherit the original submission date?
Which validation layers apply - structural, code-list, cross-field, cross-record - and in which order are they executed?
How is each validation failure identified so a requester or agent can locate and fix it?
Which rules are enforced at submission time versus after receipt, and what is the consequence of that placement?
When a rule set changes, are previously accepted requests revalidated, and how is a legacy pass recorded?
Which instants are captured for this request and which one starts the legally relevant period?
Which clock and time zone are authoritative when the requester and the receiving body are in different zones, and how are out-of-hours and deadline-day submissions treated?
What must the acknowledgement of receipt tell the requester, and within what period must it be issued?
How is receipt proven if the acknowledgement is never delivered or is disputed?
Through which channel was the request submitted, and which channels are formally equivalent for this procedure?
Can a non-resident or cross-border requester complete this procedure through the same channel with a foreign identity means?
What accessibility and assisted-route provision exists for requesters who cannot use the primary channel?
Does the channel affect the legal treatment of the request - fees, deadlines, evidence, or the reply format owed?
What binds the request content to its submitter in a way that resists later repudiation?
How is integrity of the as-captured record demonstrated at any later date?
At what point is the request formally captured as a record, and what becomes immutable at that point?
How will the record remain interpretable if its original format or signature algorithm becomes obsolete?
What is the complete set of states this request can occupy, and which are terminal?
Which state transitions are permitted, who may trigger each, and what precondition must hold?
How is the technical processing state distinguished from the business status the requester is told about?
How is a request recorded that should never have existed, as distinct from one properly cancelled or withdrawn?
Which change classes are permitted after submission, and until which point in the lifecycle?
Does an amendment create a new version of the same request or a new request that supersedes the old one?
What effect does each change class have on the effective submission date and the running deadline?
On withdrawal, what is retained, what is returned, and what is the requester told?
What processing period applies, on what legal basis, and where was it published in advance?
From which recorded instant does the period run, and how is that instant chosen when receipt is staged across components?
Under which conditions may the clock be suspended or extended, who authorises it, and what notice is owed before expiry?
What happens on expiry - deemed grant, deemed refusal, or continued duty to decide - and how is that outcome recorded?
Is an estimated completion date communicated to the requester, and how is it revised?
Which event types must be recorded for a request, and is the history append-only?
For each event, is the event instant recorded separately from the observation or ingestion instant?
Which agent, human or software, is attributed to each event, and on whose behalf did it act?
How long is the event history retained relative to the request content, and can it be disposed of separately?
Which body is competent for this request, on what jurisdictional or subject-matter basis, and who determined that?
When a request is transferred, what date does the receiving body treat as receipt, and is the requester notified?
Into which processing track is the request placed, on what criteria, and can the requester request expedition?
How is priority or queue position made auditable so that ordering can be shown to be non-arbitrary?
What disposition ended the request's own lifecycle, and when?
If a case or proceeding was opened, what is its identifier and what is the typed relation between request and case?
Can one request open several cases, or several requests be consolidated into one case, and how is that recorded?
Where the request is refused at intake, what reasons must be given and which redress route is stated?
After disposition, does the request record remain independently addressable and queryable for status?
Under which instrument is the body empowered to require this request and this information, and is that instrument cited to the requester?
Is the request voluntary or mandatory, and what follows from not providing a given item?
Is a collection approval, control number or equivalent registration required before the form may be used, and is it current?
What burden does the request impose on the requester, and is that estimate published?
What charge applies to this request, on what basis, and does it vary by channel or requester category?
Is payment a precondition of admissibility, and what is the effect of non-payment on the clock and the disposition?
On what grounds may a fee be waived, reduced or refunded, and who decides?
When may a charge be refused as excessive, or a request refused as manifestly unfounded, and who bears the burden of showing that?
Which determinations trigger a duty to give reasons, and to what standard of specificity?
Which redress routes are available, with what deadlines, and were they stated to the requester in writing?
Is the requester entitled to be heard or to correct the record before an adverse determination is made?
How is the notification instant established for the purpose of starting the redress clock?
Which categories of personal data does this request contain, and are any of them special-category or otherwise heightened-risk?
What is the lawful basis for processing each category, and does that basis persist after disposition?
Which body is controller and which are processors or joint controllers for this request, including exchange intermediaries?
What minimisation was applied - which requested items were reduced, redacted or not collected - and on what assessment?
Can the requester exercise data-subject rights over this request record, and how does that interact with the procedure's own retention duty?
Who may read, amend and dispose of this request, and at what granularity is that expressed?
Which parts of the request are publicly disclosable and which are withheld, on what stated ground?
How does the requester's own access to their request differ from third-party or public access?
Do access markings and controls travel with the record when it is exported or transferred to another body?
Which retention rule applies to this request, from which classification and under which disposition authority?
What event starts the retention period, and how is that trigger detected reliably?
Do withdrawn, refused-at-intake and entered-in-error requests follow the same rule as accepted ones?
What disposal actions are permitted, and what evidence of disposal is kept after the content is gone?
How is a legal hold applied and released, and what does it override?
Which external profiles is this request expected to be expressed in, and which elements have no counterpart in each?
Is a mapping asserted as an alignment or claimed as conformance, and what evidence supports a conformance claim?
How are correlation identifiers preserved across an exchange so a response can be matched to the original request?
What happens when the receiving system's profile version differs from the sending system's?
Which activity generated each version of the request record, and which agent was associated with that activity?
From which prior entities was this request derived - a draft, a previous request, a pre-filled dataset?
Where a software agent acted, on whose authority did it act and how is that delegation recorded?
Which custody boundaries did the record cross, and was integrity verified at each crossing?
Which measures are computed over request records, and from exactly which recorded instants and codes?
How is timeliness measured against the statutory period, including suspended and extended cases?
Which measures are published, at what aggregation, and how is disclosure of small cohorts prevented from re-identifying requesters?
How are intake quality problems - rejection rate, deficiency rate, channel abandonment - fed back into the form and rules?
If the submission channel is unavailable at or near a deadline, what fallback exists and how is the outage evidenced?
How are retried or duplicated submissions distinguished from genuine repeat requests?
How is a record that should never have existed marked and treated, and is it destroyed or retained annotated?
When an upstream evidence provider or exchange partner fails, what error is surfaced to the requester and what is the recovery path?
How are partial submissions and abandoned drafts treated - are they records at all?

grok_only.name: Which master-system identifier is authoritative for this application instance, which system assigned it, and what is its identifier type?
Does a governed global IRI exist for this application distinct from the Public Service catalogue identifier and from any case identifier?
Is this filing part of a composite requisition or group of related requests, and if so what shared identifier binds them?
Which prior application or request does this filing replace, amend, or fulfil, and is the prior record revoked or superseded?
Is this filing a proposal, plan, directive, order, or another authorised intent, and is that intent immutable after capture?
Which categories partition this request for search, access control or routing, and from which controlled vocabulary?
What priority applies, who set it, and does it override default processing time for the channel or service?
Is the request a prohibition of an action rather than a request to perform one?
Which Public Service or procedure catalogue entry is this application invoking, and what is that service's identifier and name?
What coded activity, procedure or service is being requested or ordered beyond the catalogue reference?
Is the referenced Public Service currently offered (catalogue status), and is that distinct from this application's request status?
Who or what is the subject of the requested service, and which master identity is used?
Is the applicant the same agent as the subject, and if not what is the applicant's identity?
For each attached evidence, which agent is the evidence about, and does that match the application subject?
Who or what is requesting the service, and in what capacity relative to the subject?
Which participation roles are recorded (competent authority, service user, provider, representative) and who fills each?
Is this application a reported rather than primary record, and who reported it?
Which Public Organization is the competent authority for the requested service, and is that the same body that will process this filing?
What kind of performer is desired and is a specific performer, care team or organisation named?
Who should receive the result of the request, and at which location or endpoint?
Through which channel was this application lodged, who owns that channel, and what is its type?
Did the chosen channel impose different evidence or signature requirements than the service-level default?
What cost is payable by the citizen or business for this execution, and is it channel-dependent?
Was the channel within opening hours and free of availability restrictions at lodging time?
Which life or business event triggered this application, and what is that event's identifier and name?
Why is the service needed or prohibited for this subject, in coded and/or narrative form?
Does the instance reason align with the catalogue event that the Public Service is related to, or is this an atypical use?
Which legal resources authorise or constrain this procedure, and at what identifier or ELI?
Which operational rules does this public service follow for accepting and processing the application?
Which hard constraints (minimum age, residency, thresholds) apply to this filing's information concepts?
Which requirements and criteria does this application have to satisfy, and which information concepts must be evidenced?
If criteria are weighted or biased for evaluation, what weights, weighting type and consideration description apply?
For each requirement, has evidence been provided, reused, waived, or is it still outstanding?
What evidence objects are attached or linked, of which evidence types, and which requirements or information concepts do they support?
Who created, legally issued, and transmitted each evidence object, and what is its confidentiality classification?
During which period does each evidence hold true, and does it still satisfy the evidence type's validity-period constraint at assessment time?
What additional supporting information, specimens, notes or patient/applicant instructions accompany the request but are not formal evidence types?
Relative to the applicable evidence type list, which required items are present, missing, waived, or substituted?
Was any evidence reused under the once-only principle rather than collected again from the applicant, and from which authority?
Did this procedure use the cross-border automated evidence-exchange technical system, and what was the outcome?
Is the evidence collected limited to what is necessary for the specified purpose of this procedure?
Does this application initiate a new case, join an existing case, or remain uncased, and what is the case identifier?
Which CaseFileItem represents this application in the case file, and what is its definition type and name?
Which case roles are authorised in the resulting case, and how do they map from application participants?
What output is this application expected to produce (permit, decision, report, physical object), and is that output already referenced?
Must other public services be executed first, and have their outputs been supplied as evidence?
Is this request tied to an encounter, episode, care plan or other operational context?
What is the current request-intention status and the reason for that status?
Is fulfilment being tracked separately from this status, and if so on which task or case plan items?
Was the application entered in error, and what corrective action replaced or nullified it?
Has this application been captured as a record, by which records system, and under which classification or file code?
What is the CaseFileItem lifecycle state of this application in the case file (for example available or discarded)?
Which roles are assigned responsibility for creating, capturing, monitoring and disposing of this application record?
Has the applicant withdrawn the application, when, and does the record remain captured for evidence of the transaction?
Is the request on hold or revoked, by whom, and what status reason applies?
If the application was amended, is the amendment a patch to the same record or a replacing request with lineage?
When was this request created or transitioned to active, in RFC 3339 with an explicit offset or Z?
When should the requested service occur or not occur — as an instant, period or timing schedule?
What processing-time duration does the service or channel commit to, and has it been exceeded relative to authored or capture time?
If observation or ingestion time differs from the applicant's event time of lodging, what are both values?
Which administrative region or jurisdiction does the requested service and competent authority cover, and is the subject in-scope?
Where should the service be performed, if location-specific?
If lodged in person, at which office or address was the application received?
Who captured, classified, classified-security, modified or transmitted this application record, using which system, and when?
What integrity measure (hash, signature, seal) protects the application payload and each evidence item?
On what basis is the application asserted authentic and reliable (original capture, qualified signature, registry-sourced evidence)?
Can the record still be interpreted in the business context of the people and processes that created it, including language and rendering?
What is the specified, explicit and legitimate purpose and lawful basis for processing personal data on this application?
Which personal data elements are necessary for this procedure, and which were collected in excess or not collected under minimisation?
Are personal data accurate and up to date, and what rectification or erasure steps have been taken without delay?
What confidentiality or security classification applies to the application and to each evidence item?
Who may read this application at bundle, layer, finding and artefact scope, and under what purpose limitation?
What access exceptions exist (legal privilege, whistleblower, sealed minor, law-enforcement overlay)?
What audit events must be retained to demonstrate who accessed or altered the application and its evidence?
What records retention schedule and disposal action apply to this application and its evidence?
When does the GDPR storage-limitation clock expire for identifiable personal data, and is further processing solely archival, research or statistical?
Has the record been deleted, anonymised, or transferred to an archive, and what evidential residue remains?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
